reason: Adds a browser microphone control to the DeepSeek Harness chat input, using Web Speech API speech recognition to insert transcribed text and optionally send it automatically.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框添加麦克风按钮，将浏览器语音识别结果填入聊天草稿，并可选择自动发送。
summaries.en: Adds a microphone button to the DeepSeek Harness Web chat input, inserting browser speech-recognition transcripts into the draft with optional automatic submission.

capabilities: accesses microphone input through the browser
converts speech to text for the chat draft
can optionally submit the recognized text automatically
